benchmark_description: Traffic surveillance dataset recorded at 24 urban intersections. V3 development setup uses temporal stride sampling across sequences.
sampling_interval_note: Sampled at uniform temporal intervals across video sequences. Sampled frames represent the active training/validation benchmark, not the total uncompressed raw sequence frame count (~139k frames).

train.role: Training split with extensive multi-condition coverage

val.role: V3 validation split for hyperparameter tuning and model checkpoint selection

test.role: Held-out test sequences reserved for independent evaluation
